items.sourceText: At six thirty tomorrow morning, Minh will meet Professor Nguyen beside Hoan Kiem Lake.

items.sourceText: Lan pushed version two point four point one to GitHub before the Friday demo.

items.sourceText: The temperature in Sa Pa fell to minus two degrees Celsius, but the sensor still worked.

items.sourceText: Please call the API only after Docker reports that the health check has passed.

items.sourceText: The retrieval pipeline combines embeddings, vector search, and RAG to answer each question.

items.sourceText: Set the learning rate to zero point zero zero one, then run the Python script again.

items.sourceText: The JSON response contains an access token, so never print it in the debug log.

items.sourceText: After the pull request passed CI, Huy deployed the service to the staging environment.

items.sourceText: The recommendation engine uses cosine similarity to rank the top ten videos.

items.sourceText: Enable two factor authentication before connecting the production database to the dashboard.
